prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / terrain outpainting.
Asset: ONE continuous top-down ground-only master for the next two adjoining sections of the Safety Last game.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a 3072 × 1660 outpaint template. Its LEFT 704 pixels are existing camp ground, and its BOTTOM 256 pixels are the already approved northern trail. Replace the white missing space and the obsolete black boundary fade with new ground. Preserve the leftmost 128 pixels and bottommost 128 pixels exactly at their current position and scale. No zoom, crop, framing change or movement of existing artwork.
Input 2 is the PRIMARY style and ground-cover reference: the recently approved sparse brown/olive terrain and dirt trail. Input 3 is the geographic overview only: this extension moves north/northeast toward village outskirts, with works farther east. Do not render its miniature buildings or trees.

Continue the bottom trail north into a slightly more open village outskirts area. Its dirt path enters from the BOTTOM at about 65–68% of image width, with a few embedded pale paving remnants at the existing contact. Continue this SAME entry faithfully. The main route gently bends left, then continues NORTH leaving the TOP at about 58% of width. Let it gradually widen into a worn DIRT LANE (roughly 280–330 pixels wide at input scale in its northern half), with a little gravel and only occasional isolated flat old paving fragments. Include one narrower dirt footpath branching east in the upper half, leaving the RIGHT edge around 35–40% of image height. Use natural worn curves, not ruler-straight roads or a formal crossroads.

Most NEW terrain must be calm, open GROUND: large irregular patches of bare chestnut/umber earth, grey-brown compacted soil near the lane, and muted olive/green flat grassy areas. Some subtly darker earth gives regional variation. Blend naturally into both existing edges, without straight colour bands. Leave irregular open clearings beside the lane for later separately placed assets. Keep texture sharp and hand-painted at the exact small material scale of the input; soft neutral overhead daylight, flat ground plane. Sparse fine gravel, not wall-to-wall paving texture. Grassy areas are low surface texture, not raised tufts or shrubs.

VERY IMPORTANT: no carpet of orange/red leaves or flower shapes. At least 85–90% of the NEW ground should have no leaves at all. Only a few small, subdued brown fallen leaves in 3–5 isolated clusters near the transition edge. Most ground can simply be dirt or grass. Preserve the existing warm leafier LEFT contact instead of spreading it into the new region.

Output one opaque landscape texture at 3072:1660 aspect ratio, highest resolution available, ideally 3072 × 1660. Fully detailed ground to all edges. No black fade, white gaps, borders, vignette, text, symbols, grid, panels, trees, bushes, tall plants, big rocks, buildings, walls, fences, rails, water, puddles, people, props, or cast shadows. No blur. Preserve the paths and both known contact strips, outpaint only the missing terrain.

references.editTarget: Matching camp and northern-trail contact strips at (4096,456), 3072 × 1660
